title: Material
description: A material (#774): an item the loot, harvest and chest tables may give that isn't a piece of gear, kept in the player's profile by its id with how many they have. One file per material, named after its id, so the content flow can refuse a table naming an item that doesn't exist. An id is never reused or changed once shipped.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

name.description: The player-facing name (#1657), as the Character tab and a loot burst show it.

category.description: What kind of material it is (#2281), so a reader can tell one from another by its data, not by a list of ids: a tonic refuses every mineral (rock, ore, a shard or core of rock) and every metal (#2038). A plant grows; an animal part comes from a creature; a liquid is drunk or poured; a catalyst is mana that sets a change off; an essence is an element made into a thing.

model.description: Its 3D model (every item has one, #1579): a model id in the resource packs (#1864) that a pack has. Optional until every material has one (#1585, #1586).
